headline: 200 bhori gold, 25 lakh BDT looted from jewelry shop in Rajshahi
summary: Thieves broke through a wall to steal a massive amount of gold and cash from a store in Rajshahi.
details: A jewelry shop in Rajshahi was targeted by thieves who broke through a wall to gain entry to the premises.
The thieves managed to loot 200 bhori of gold and 25 lakh BDT in cash from the shop.
The theft occurred while the shop was closed, allowing the perpetrators to carry out the heist without immediate detection.
Local authorities have been notified and are investigating the process by which the thieves entered the and the stolen assets.

headline: Video viral: Police Commissioner threatens to beat inspector if info leaked
summary: A video has surfaced online showing a high-ranking police official making aggressive threats against a subordinate officer.
details: A video has gone viral on social media platforms showing a Police Commissioner threatening a subordinate inspector.
In the footage, the Commissioner is heard warning the inspector that he would be 'hung from a tree and beaten' if any confidential information was leaked.
The aggressive nature of the threats and the language used by the high-ranking official have sparked widespread criticism and debate online.
The police department has not yet issued an official statement regarding the authenticity of the video or the possible disciplinary actions against the official involved.
